newsitem.title: USA: Pride Petroleum revised Q1 net shr $1.46.
newsitem.headline: Pride Petroleum revised Q1 net shr $1.46.

text.p: Pride Petroleum Services Inc on Friday revised its first quarter earnings, saying the net share was $1.46, as compared to the $1.15 previously reported.
The company said the change came from revisions of certain non-recurring items and that earnings from operations remain $0.23 a share.
The company said its revised gain on the sale of its U.S. land-based well servicing operations after estimated income taxes was $53,453,000, rather than $54,568,000.

It also said it has decided to reflect the costs of the business combination with Forasol-Foramer as part of the purchase price of the Forasol-Foramer units rather than as an after tax charge of $13.3 million.
Finally, it said its after tax charge for converting $28 million of its 6-1/4 percent subordinated debt was $3,732,000, rather than $4,648,000.
